Leah (Billing Ops): Helix AI (customer) flagged INV-2026-0789 — promo credit code HELIX-FEB not applied at billing run. Customer expects $3,000 promo line, invoice shows full charge. Link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-0789
Evan (Acct Manager): They've been on the HELIX-FEB test promo since Jan. Evan: they pinged support this morning. Can billing confirm whether the promo was attached to the subscription at cutoff?
Leah (Billing Ops): Quick audit: subscription shows promo active in UI but the invoice table has no promo line. Raw usage shows normal usage of 1.2M tokens 
Leah (Billing Ops): Calc: expected promo credit = $3,000; billed amount = $9,750; expected net = $6,750; diff = $3,000. They also asked for a small goodwill for the confusion: $500.
Ravi (Finance): Policy: usage corrections -> adjust invoice to reflect promo (-$3,000). Goodwill <= $500 can be approved by Finance; anything >$500 needs Director sign-off. So this is within range. Propose: invoice adjustment (-$3,000) + goodwill credit $500 -> total credit $3,500. GL code: FIN-ADJ-02.
Tina (Legal): FYI ensure note: "promo not applied due to billing match error during cutoff; no customer action required" in ticket. No contract change.
Evan (Acct Manager): Customer prefers a two-line credit on next invoice or immediate refund. Which is faster?
Ravi (Finance): We typically post a credit memo for the correction and apply it to next invoice unless they request an immediate refund. Immediate refund requires payment ops and takes 3-5 business days. Ask the customer preference.
Leah (Billing Ops): I messaged Helix: "We can apply a two-line credit to your next invoice (recommended) or issue a refund. Which do you prefer?"
Leah (Billing Ops): Helix replied: "Please refund to the card on file if possible — the cashflow hit is urgent."
Ravi (Finance): OK—since goodwill <=$500 and prefer refund, I'll approve the refund flow. Will route to payments team. Posting journal entry template: ```DR Accounts Payable 3,500
CR Revenue 3,500
Memo: INV-2026-0789 adjustment + goodwill```.
billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-9992, amount 3500, GL: FIN-ADJ-02, action: refund to card, payment ops owner: @payments-team, est complete: 2026-03-27.
Tina (Legal): Confirmed. Keep the email thread for audit.
Ravi (Finance): I approve the refund and GL. @Leah please attach the Helix acceptance email and the refund confirmation once done.
Leah (Billing Ops): Will do. Noting in billing system: `adj:TKT-9992` and will follow up when payment ops confirms refund executed. :white_check_mark:
